source.name: SportsPro – Juventus and Jeep reunite in new €69m shirt sponsorship deal
source.quote: The club will then gain €19 million (US$21.4 million) for the 2025/26 campaign and then €23 million (US$25.9 million) for subsequent years.

note: SportsPro: Jeep pays €69m in total through 2028 (€4m for the rest of 2024/25, €19m for 2025/26, €23m per year after). Calcio e Finanza puts the combined Jeep+Visit Detroit front at €28-30m per season.
